messages.en:
So...whatcha been up to?
Me? I've been great!
messages.et:
Nii...mis sa teinud oled?
Mina? Mul on läinud hästi!

messages.en:
I've been eating a lot of
fruit since you left.
messages.et:
Olen sinu lahkumisest
saati palju puuvilja söönud.

messages.en:
How did you like our fair
town? I wanna see yours!
messages.et:
Kuidas sulle meie linn
meeldis? Tahan su oma näha!

messages.en:
When I feel sleepy, I think
of your face to wake up!
messages.et:
Kui mul on uni, mõtlen
su näost, et ärkvele jääda!

messages.en:
That smirk of yours is
kind of scary, you know.
messages.et:
See sinu muie on
kuidagi hirmus, tead.

messages.en:
Nothing's changed here,
and that's A-OK with me!
messages.et:
Siin pole midagi muutunud
ja see sobib mulle täiesti!

messages.en:
Hi-ho! What's new? It's
me! You know, ME!
messages.et:
Hi-hoo! Mis uudist? Mina
siin! Tead küll, MINA!

messages.en:
If you're reading this, it
means you got home safe!
messages.et:
Kui sa seda loed, siis
jõudsid turvaliselt koju!

messages.en:
I guess you're happiest at
home after all?
messages.et:
Vist oled sa ikkagi
kodus kõige õnnelikum?

messages.en:
I dance to {04 11 00}
all the time! WAHOOOO!

Dang it! It's boring here
without you! BO-RING!
messages.et:
Pagan! Siin on ilma sinuta
igav! I-GAV!

messages.en:
You miss me tons, don't
you? I knew it!
messages.et:
Sa igatsed mind kohutavalt,
kas pole? Teadsin!

messages.en:
I have something to say.
Tell {04 0f 00}, OK?
messages.et:
Mul on midagi öelda.
Ütle {04 0f 00}-le, eks?

messages.en:
I still haven't forgotten
you! Come visit again, OK?
messages.et:
Ma pole sind ikka veel
unustanud! Tule jälle, eks?

messages.en:
Hello! {0b 03 00}{04 0f 00}! Make
up your mind, will ya?

How are you? {0b 03 00}{04 17 00}
is sleepy. It's boring!
messages.et:
Kuidas läheb? {0b 03 00}{04 17 00}
on unine. On igav!
